column3: 'No entries yet. The board is wide open.'
'One attempt, on video. Ends at midnight on the last day of {month}.'
'One continuous clip, whole body in frame, from start to last rep.'
'Your score goes in as pending. Nobody sees it until it is checked.'
'Clean reps count. Verified scores go straight onto the board.'
'The top three each month get a permanent trophy on their profile.'
'Share a win, a question, a form check…'
'In this web preview, photos stay until you reload the page.'
'Every session you finish lands here, grouped by month.'
'Your history is safe. Go Pro to keep logging.'
'No sessions yet. Your first one starts your records and the week strip above.'
'English is the default. Pick another language for menus and buttons; guides and posts stay in the language they were written in.'
'Translations are made by Cali. Spot a mistake? Tell us and we will fix it.'
'Restart Cali to switch the layout direction.'
'Every guide links to its original. Videos open on YouTube. Breakdowns are written by Cali; photos credited on each guide.'
'This guide is no longer in the library.'
'The best guides and videos we could find, broken down step by step for your ladders.'
'Photo: {credit}. The original article image is no longer online.'
'Video by {channel}. Cali links to it; we do not host or edit it.'
'This video is no longer in the library.'
'Add exercises as you go. Tick a set and the rest timer starts on its own.'
'Your free trial has ended. Every session you logged is safe and still viewable.'
'Sample chats until launch. Messages you send are kept on this phone.'
'Your history is all still here. Go Pro to keep logging.'
'Your history always stays viewable, Pro or not.'
'Back us early and lock in the launch price for the whole year.'
'Everything is unlocked until then. History stays yours after.'
'Get a session in before the day does'
Removes the account and everything stored with it. Can't be undone.
'Everything lives on this phone until you sign in.'
'Keep your sessions, trial and ranks across phones.'
'No verified scores on this board yet. The first person to submit takes the top spot.'
'Log this skill to see your best here'
'Only video-verified scores count. Submitting yours with a clip opens with the first monthly challenge.'
'Log a session and your records start filling in here, exercise by exercise.'
'Post the first one. Up to 3 minutes.'
'Back up your sessions, keep your trial across phones, and get on the boards.'
'No password. New here? This creates your account.'
Accounts aren't available in this build.
'Every step done. You own this skill.'
'Steps tick themselves off when you log them.'
'Trial ended. Your progress stays; go Pro to tick off new steps.'
'Sharing outside Cali works in the phone app.'
'Camera access is off. Turn it on in Settings to record.'
'Write a caption… what are you working on?'
'Could not open your photos. Try again.'
'Training, progress, form checks and fun. No hate, nudity or dangerous stunts. Anyone can report a post.'
'This video is {len}. Shorts can be up to 3:00, so trim it first.'
'We could not read how long this video is. Try another one.'
'Could not open your videos. Try again.'
'In this web preview, uploads stay until you reload the page.'
'Allow location for this site in your browser to see local weather and time.'
'Turn on location for Cali in Settings to see local weather and time.'
'We could not find your location. Check that location services are on.'
'Live temperature, conditions and the local time, with a tip for today’s session.'
'Cold. Warm up wrists and shoulders twice as long before holds.'
'Hot out. Shorter sets, longer rests, keep water close.'
'Thunderstorm. Stay off metal bars today; train indoors.'
'UV is high. Find shade for long holds and handstands.'
'Very hot. Train early or late, in shade, and drink more than you think.'
'Wet bars are slippery. Chalk up, dry the bar, or go indoors.'
'Windy. Handstands outside will be harder today.'
'From your first pull-up to a clean muscle-up. Track every rep, unlock every step, and see where you stand.'
'Pick up to {n}. Home will lead with these.'
'Be honest. We use this to skip the steps you already own.'
'This name shows on leaderboards. You can change it anytime.'
'Everything unlocked. Your history stays yours, whatever you decide after.'
